en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a tall stone bell and clock tower with arched windows and a red roof topped by a cross. The tower stands in a green park-like area with trees and a building with a red roof in the background. At the top of the card there is printed Romanian text identifying the view, and in the upper right corner there is a Romanian postage stamp with a circular postmark.
